# Contributing to InkShelf

Thanks for helping improve InkShelf.

## Before opening an issue

Please search existing issues first.

InkShelf is a fork of TachiyomiJ2K. If a problem also occurs in the upstream reader or the wider Mihon ecosystem, mention that in the report.

Issues relating only to third-party extensions or sources do not belong in the InkShelf repository.

## Bug reports

Please include:

- InkShelf version/build
- Android version
- device/model
- steps to reproduce
- expected behaviour
- actual behaviour
- screenshots or logs where useful

Do not include passwords, API keys, personal data or private library/back-up files in logs or screenshots.

## Feature requests

Explain the problem the feature would solve and how you expect it to behave.

Focused requests are easier to review than several unrelated ideas in one issue.

## Pull requests

Keep changes focused and avoid unrelated refactors.

For reader or UI changes, test at least:

- phone portrait
- rotation/landscape
- normal Library startup
- Discover
- Reader navigation

Do not commit local SDK paths, signing keys, API keys, Firebase configuration, personal backups or generated build folders.
